requirements.summary: Approve Swiss VAT liability, place of supply, invoice requirements, UID treatment, and cross-border service treatment.
Apply the Swiss FADP, transparent privacy information, processor controls, and safeguards for cross-border personal-data transfers.
Provide clear operator identity, contracting steps, input correction, immediate order confirmation, and accurate withdrawal information.
Apply destination VAT for qualifying EU consumer services and use an approved OSS or Merchant-of-Record model.
Validate business status and VAT IDs and preserve evidence for applicable cross-border reverse-charge treatment.
Complete controller and processor disclosures, Article 28 terms, transfer safeguards, rights workflows, and regional provider review.
Review pre-contract information, withdrawal, digital-service performance, renewal, cancellation, refunds, and national implementation rules.
Provide the electronic withdrawal function required by applicable national implementation of EU distance-contract rules.
Approve local VAT or Merchant-of-Record treatment because non-EU EEA countries are outside EU OSS.
Determine UK place of supply, customer status, VAT registration, evidence, and Merchant-of-Record treatment for digital services.
Apply UK GDPR transparency and assess restricted transfers using adequacy, the IDTA, UK Addendum, and transfer risk requirements.
Track commencement and implementation of DMCCA subscription disclosures, reminders, cooling-off, cancellation, and refund rules.
Determine SaaS and software taxability, economic nexus, registration, exemption certificates, and filing obligations by state and locality.
Maintain a current state-law applicability matrix for notices, consumer rights, sensitive data, contracts, and opt-out mechanisms.
Review federal and state negative-option, free-to-paid Trial, renewal notice, consent, and cancellation requirements before B2C launch.
Classify relevant software and encryption, screen restricted parties, and enforce current BIS and OFAC restrictions.
Select and contract a Merchant of Record with verified country, currency, tax, refund, invoice, and webhook coverage.
Assess Australian GST registration, consumer status, ABN evidence, and Merchant-of-Record responsibility for imported digital services.
Assess Australian Privacy Act applicability, APP notices, overseas disclosure accountability, provider contracts, and rights operations.
Review Australian Consumer Law guarantees, transparent pricing, unfair standard terms, renewal, cancellation, and small-business protections.
Assess Canadian GST/HST registration, consumer location, monthly subscription supplies, provincial tax, business evidence, and platform responsibility.
Map PIPEDA and substantially similar provincial privacy laws, cross-border processing accountability, notices, contracts, and rights workflows.
Review online-contract, pricing, renewal, cancellation, language, and disclosure requirements separately for each supported province and territory.
Assess New Zealand GST registration, customer evidence, business treatment, quarterly filing, and marketplace responsibility for remote services.
Assess Privacy Act 2020 applicability, Principle 12 overseas disclosure safeguards, provider agency roles, notices, and rights workflows.
Review Fair Trading Act and Consumer Guarantees Act duties for informed subscription consent, renewals, cancellation, refunds, and unfair terms.
